name: Authum Investment & Infrastructure Ltd
about: Authum Investment & Infrastructure Limited is engaged in the business of fund-based activities viz, investment in shares, securities, mutual funds etc. and providing loans and advances, etc. [1]
keyPoints:
Business Segments
1) Investments (89%): [1] The company invests in publicly listed and unlisted companies, private equity investments, real estate investments, and debt instruments. Also, it has been engaged in structured financing, fixed returns portfolios, secured lending, and equity investments in emerging companies. The total investments increased from 3,186 Cr in FY22 to Rs. 15,592 Cr as of Q2 FY26. [2] [3] [4][5]

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 70.0% CAGR over last 5 years
Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 27.0%
